hooks.command: BIN="$(command -v oxfmt 2>/dev/null || ([ -x ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt ] && echo ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt))"; if [ -z "$BIN" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"pre-push format check skipped: oxfmt not found — run npm install"}'; exit 0; fi; if "$BIN" --check . >/tmp/purity-prepush-fmt.log 2>&1; then exit 0; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Pre-push formatting check failed (oxfmt --check). Run `npm run format` to auto-fix, then retry the push. Details in /tmp/purity-prepush-fmt.log"}}'; exit 0; fi
